description: Examines the Compson family through four narrative sections, connecting broken chronology, race, gender, loss, and the struggle to understand others. Covers Faulkner: What Exactly Is Falling Apart in the Old South?; How to Read The Sound and the Fury Without Flattening It; The Sound and the Fury: How the Book Was Made and Why It Matters.
